scope: Static source inspection of the House native result/import path, conditional archive adapter, joint archive decoder/checker, and House expected-error scorecard sidecar. No owner-tree edits, large archive reads, builds, tests, refits, publication, or actual-result evaluation.

inspected_sources.areas: V1/V2 request, exact archive members, combined draw identities, validation and fail-closed exit
Conditional NPZ and segmented-manifest readers; V2 plan/receipt/output binding
Explicit roots, staging policy, evidence resolution, joint archive check, release validation
V1/V2 plan/receipt selection and conditional-storage binding
Offline decoder invocation and row stream handling
Native race probabilities and chamber summary checks
Published per-race support, probabilities, conditional pair summary, chamber PMF, result identity
House scorecard expected-error sidecar validation and UI projection
Read-only identification of the scorecard's draw-level transforms and compact joint-metric output

native_joint_archive.format: NPZ of exact flat NPY members; 435 ordered current House race IDs; original row order is chain-major.

ordinary_v1_members.winner_codes.npy: int8 [N,435], codes D=0/R=1/O=2; one winner-group outcome per race and row
ordinary_v1_members.seat_counts.npy: little-endian int16 [N,3], D/R/O seats per row; checked against winner_codes
ordinary_v1_members.race_ids.npy: little-endian Unicode [435], exact order is checked against native result
ordinary_v1_members.categorical_bank_index.npy: int64 [N], required, nonnegative, value is not otherwise interpreted by the frontend checker
ordinary_v1_members.core_posterior_index.npy: int64 [N], required, nonnegative, value is not otherwise interpreted by the frontend checker
ordinary_v1_members.national_z.npy: float64 [N], required and finite, value is not otherwise interpreted by the frontend checker
ordinary_v1_members.predictive_draw.npy: int64 [N], must equal row modulo draws_per_chain

combined_v1_v2_extra_members.source_run_index.npy: int16 [N], each row's ordered source-run segment
combined_v1_v2_extra_members.source_joint_draw_id.npy: int64 [N], source-local ID; checked against each plan segment offset

native_joint_archive.weights_and_identity: No row weights are stored in the winner NPZ. Native and segment summaries use equal weight per joint row; V2 explicitly binds equal_weight_per_original_joint_row. For V2, combined global IDs are arange(N), child IDs remain local arange within each run, source segments remain ordered and contiguous, chain/draw coordinates are exact, chain lengths/warmup must align, and original seeds must be distinct.
native_joint_archive.what_each_row_enables: Race marginal winner probabilities, joint chamber seat counts/PMFs/control probabilities, tied-modal winner miss count, and preserved cross-race dependence. Row identities and source indexes support replay/audit of the selected combination.
native_joint_archive.fail_closed: Decoder requires exact member set, supported NPY version/dtypes/shapes/C-order, bounded headers and rows (7,000,000), safe pinned paths, SHA-256 and stable-file identity; rejects malformed codes, sidecar mismatches, bad race order, nonfinite national_z, negative indexes, duplicate/reordered IDs, noncontiguous source segments or invalid plan semantics. A nonzero decoder exit invalidates the stream even if bytes were emitted; the caller checks the complete row count and summary reconciliation.

required_semantic_members.shares: float64 [N,P], aligned per-row conditional named-pair shares; P is the ordered pair cohort
required_semantic_members.race_ids: Unicode [P], exact ordered identities of races with a supported named pair
required_semantic_members.joint_draw_id: int64 [N], child-local arange; V2 adapter verifies this and synthesizes/checks global arange for concatenated segments

conditional_shares_storage.other_members: The storage manifest is data-driven and records exact member names, dtypes, shapes, row axes and reader rules for every original NPY member. The adapter accepts only primitive, flat NPZ members with native C-order; preserves all member bytes and same row order. Known model examples include shared_cycle, coefficients, tau_cycle and tau_race, but this frontend adapter does not hard-code those names or interpret their values.
conditional_shares_storage.v2_segmentation: Manifest references original conditional-shares.npz sources by root-relative path and SHA, exact rows, offsets and member metadata. It requires identical race IDs, member schemas, dtype and trailing shapes; contiguous source coverage; original draw IDs; and at most 7,000,000 rows. Streaming is bounded to at most 4,096 rows per read (default 2,048). All sources are reverified during reads. No source resampling or reweighting occurs.
conditional_shares_storage.selected_plan_receipt_requirements: V2 requires explicit conditional root plus pinned manifest, V2 combined plan and passed V2 receipt. Selected outputs must be exactly diagnostics.json, joint-draws.npz, conditional-shares.index.json, conditional-group-probability-means.npy and polls.csv; their bytes are hash checked. Selected diagnostics must say race_passed=true and chamber_passed=true. Every original child plan/receipt/settings/input/output is pinned; a completed original run may have truthful diagnostic_failure, but selected V2 may not. Original configuration, law fields, input set, source code, draws/warmup, seeds, offsets and identities must reconcile.
conditional_shares_storage.validation_boundary: This adapter checks conditional share archive structure, IDs, SHA and lineage. It does not numerically compare shares to each native conditional-pair mean/quantile, validate share finiteness/range, or parse/compare conditional-group-probability-means.npy values. Those stronger share checks are performed by the separate expected-error sidecar builder (e.g. N x P shares finite in [0,1], means and p05/p95 match native result, shared joint IDs, row/seat consistency).

native_result_json_is_site_payload: Per-race D/R/O group win probabilities and candidate/group memberships across 435 races
Where applicable, named-pair mean, p05/p10/p50/p90/p95/p975 quantiles, first candidate exceeds half, close and 10-point event probabilities, and denominator/qualifications
When chamber summary is qualified: D/R/O 436-cell seat PMFs, expected seats, p05/p10/p50/p90/p95, and D/R/unresolved majority probabilities
published_summaries_and_scorecard.expected_error_scorecard_inputs: The House expected-error sidecar is bound to exact result SHA, run/configuration/cutoffs, source pin hashes, row count/chain count, 435 ordered winner IDs, ordered pair IDs (current sidecar protocol: 412 supported pairs and 23 inapplicable), pair mask and equal row weights. It provides one modal group call and one pair-error status per race, four joint summary metrics, precision diagnostics, qualifications and limitations.
scorecard_draw_transforms: Per row: mean signed pair-margin error across equal-weight supported pairs
Per row: mean absolute pair-margin error across equal-weight supported pairs
Per row: number of supported pair draws within each frozen p05/p95 interval (inclusive endpoints)
Per row: count of races where simulated group winner differs from frozen modal group
published_summaries_and_scorecard.scorecard_joint_metric_archive: Builder stores only N x 4 float64 joint-metric values plus metric_names, joint_draw_id, predictive_chain and predictive_draw. The JSON sidecar stores per-race expected absolute margin errors/modal calls and joint means, SDs, quantiles, MCSE, rank R-hat, plus PMF for the two discrete count metrics. Runtime scorecard projection validates summary arithmetic/identity from the JSON reference; it does not stream raw posterior arrays or actual election results.
published_summaries_and_scorecard.scorecard_fail_closed: Reference must match the current dated forecast edition/result hash, qualification, dimensions, source pins, ordered IDs, exact tie rule and modal calls. It validates 435 race entries, 412 applicable pairs/23 inapplicable pairs, PMF integer-count resolution, moments/quantiles, expected modal misses and pair-error aggregate consistency. Mismatch returns unavailable reference; it does not mark the forecast as scored or consume actual results.

compact_or_regenerate_assessment.frontend_minimum_for_existing_display: Site display can use the already-published native result JSON plus the exact compact expected-error sidecar JSON; raw NPZ arrays are offline importer/audit inputs and are deliberately never staged. Keep result and scorecard sidecar hashes/bindings and source pins.
compact_or_regenerate_assessment.minimum_for_import_time_native_joint_rec: To reproduce all existing row-level marginal, seat-PMF, control-probability and joint scorecard checks, retain each aligned winner row (or a lossless encoding), ordered race IDs, row/chain/draw IDs, and for combined runs source-run/local-draw IDs plus exact ordered plans/weights. Marginal win counts and seat PMFs alone can validate summaries but destroy joint dependence and cannot replay cross-race miss distributions or row/source identity.
compact_or_regenerate_assessment.minimum_for_regenerating_expected_error_: Retain aligned per-row winner_codes for all races, conditional shares for every supported pair, joint_draw_id and predictive chain/draw IDs, ordered winner/pair race IDs, frozen native pair means/intervals and modal groups, equal per-row/equal-pair definitions, and the plan/receipt/configuration/input/driver bindings. Without conditional shares, per-race margin errors and pair interval-coverage metrics are irrecoverable from winner codes. Without winner rows, modal-group miss counts and their joint distribution are irrecoverable from pair shares. The four N x 1 joint metric vectors suffice to reproduce joint aggregate scorecard summaries, but not the per-race margin-error breakdown or independent recomputation from underlying predictions.
compact_or_regenerate_assessment.regeneration_route: Refitting/rerunning original forecast jobs is a possible recovery route only if all pinned source inputs, source code, configurations, seeds, chain settings, dependencies/runtime and exact build behavior remain available. The frontend importer does not itself regenerate forecasts or source arrays; it authenticates existing artifacts. No regeneration guarantee is established by this inspection.

limitations: This is a frontend/native-reader inventory, not a forecast correctness or scientific qualification review.
No actual House prediction archive was opened, hashed, decoded or compared; no heavy process was run.
Existing imported native JSON contains summaries, so raw individual draws are not needed for ordinary site display once offline validation is complete.
The frontend's 7,000,000-row limits and structure checks do not prove correct model fitting, useful forecast skill, or that every scientific diagnostic is independently reproduced.
No production or Senate/House owner directory was modified; this record is lab-only.
